verdict.rationale: Greptile documents several noise controls. There is a 1–3 strictness setting, and a noise-control mode skips low-impact or repetitive feedback. You can also filter comment types and ignore files. The learning system uses 👍/👎 reactions and replies to stop comments the team doesn't care about. The v5 changelog claims fewer false positives, and review summaries list findings sorted by severity. One hands-on user is broadly positive but calls it 'sometimes a bit overzealous'. Missing for 10: explicit deduplication docs (only 'skipping repetitive feedback'), detail on per-comment severity labels, independent measurements of false-positive rates.
